scope: Paired operator-planned retrieval controls through the actual worker and loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture. No model inference, maintenance acceptance, or autonomous localization score.
coverage: All original lines of both target definitions must be present verbatim in actual read_file or inspect_python tool messages. Source remains unchanged.

plans.sequential_200: Read from offset zero in 200-line pages through the last required definition.
plans.literal_grep_then_span: Two literal grep calls for operator-provided function definitions, then read their combined enclosing span. Span endpoints are operator-provided AST boundaries, not model-discovered.
plans.python_outline_then_symbols: Enable existing python_source_v1; read one outline and both symbol pages with returned IDs/hashes. No other harness change.

metrics: first-request overhead including system prompt and schemas
sum of logical input tokens across requests
rendering: Pinned model's exact template bytes, Jinja2 3.1.6 reference renderer with parsed tool arguments, thinking disabled; native pinned GGUF vocabulary tokenization. This is offline reference accounting, not observed server usage, native minja equivalence, KV-cache work or latency.
limitations: Known function names and plans supplied by operator
One public source objective, not held-out or a general retrieval benchmark
Identical original task prompt/acceptance file retained, but no editing or acceptance executed
No inference, generation tokens, dollar cost or speedup measured
Logical input sum repeats cached prefixes and is not actual compute
Isolated text/schema component counts are not additive tokenizer attribution
